mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.title, n.content, n.publisher_id, n.publisher_name, n.publisher_role, u.college as publisher_college, n.is_top, n.status, n.create_time, n.update_time, CASE WHEN nr.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as is_read FROM notice n LEFT JOIN user u ON n.publisher_id = u.id LEFT JOIN notice_read nr ON nr.notice_id = n.id AND nr.user_id = #{userId} WHERE n.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (title, content, publisher_id, publisher_name, publisher_role, is_top, status, create_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{publisherId}, #{publisherName}, #{publisherRole}, #{isTop}, #{status}, #{createTime})
INSERT IGNORE INTO notice_read (notice_id, user_id, read_time) VALUES (#{noticeId}, #{userId}, NOW())
